parsed.post: Discarding the 1.0624 run; it regressed from 1.0445. The increase in LR to 0.07 was likely too aggressive for this depth/budget combo. Reverting to 4952c54. Next: testing MATRIX_LR=0.06 with WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 to see if moderate LR and warmup improve convergence for depth 4.
parsed.description: Testing a more moderate learning rate and a standard 5% warmup to see if it improves convergence stability for depth 4.
